ios.desc:
Teleprompter for Creators helps you record confident videos with fewer retakes. Write or paste a script, rehearse the scroll, switch to camera recording, then review and export your take from the same session.

MADE FOR
YouTubers, vloggers, TikTok creators, podcasters, public speakers, presenters, sales teams, journalists, and educators.

BUILT FOR RECORDING
• Script, Rehearse, and Record modes keep each shoot focused
• Smooth auto-scroll with adjustable reading speed, text size, and text color
• Built-in camera recording while the script stays on screen
• Front/back camera switching, lens selection, and HDR when available
• Instant take review after recording, with Record Another and Export actions
• Scripts and takes stay organized together
• Import .txt scripts from Files with Pro

PRO
The free plan includes one script to get started. Pro unlocks unlimited recording sessions, file imports, and export for finished takes. Pro may be offered as auto-renewing subscription plans and a lifetime purchase where available.

SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase or after any free trial shown at checkout. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage and cancel anytime in your App Store account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

CONTACT
Questions, ideas, or feedback? Write to us at hello@kwcodes.com.

Terms of Use: https://kwcodes.com/teleprompter/#terms-of-use
